decisions.reason: The Shopify and TikTok requirements cover the same current batch of 15 selected products and previously shared the five-minute deadline; extending completion to 15 minutes necessarily changes the TikTok batch deadline as well.
A same-message MODIFY already changes the current research batch deadline to within 15 minutes and requires no correction.
The source extends the current product-completion deadline but does not necessarily change the spreadsheet's structure or establish a separate spreadsheet deadline.
A same-message MODIFY already records the 15-minute current completion deadline and removes the superseded five-minute product-batch deadline.
The 15-minute deadline applies to completing the current product work before moving on to Airbnb outreach, not to the outreach requirement itself.
The source does not mention storing task artifacts, linked documents, or supporting links and does not change this requirement.
The product-batch deadline does not change how interested Airbnb host conversations must be advanced.
The source concerns completion of the current product work and does not alter the content bank's requirements or end-of-day deadline.
A deadline extension for the current batch does not change the freelancer's fallback behavior when assigned work is unavailable.
The source does not change the spreadsheet-based Airbnb lead-tracking workflow or its CRM-entry trigger.
